description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Review both repositories for explicit infrastructure ownership, immutable validated configuration, readiness and generation fencing, host authorization preservation, failure propagation and absence of duplicate stores. Verify that per-connection backend selection never silently starts infrastructure, paired state remains encrypted in Connect, and only session/sender_key use package Mnesia. Execute applicable repository gates in their owning workspaces. After implementation and PR review approval, invoke coverage-upper for ZAQ changed coverage and equivalent package coverage workflow; address justified gaps and review resulting changes. Follow authoritative ZAQ validation lifecycle through final precommit before requesting final human approval. Record exact revisions, commands, failures, residual risks and release prerequisites; never count unrelated dirty files as this work.

Tests to add before implementation:
Retain targeted tests from every step; run package default non-live suite and quality gate plus ZAQ isolated linked-device/storage/supervision/full-flow regression checks. Recovery/global-Mnesia tests run in isolated BEAMs. Run existing relevant E2E only where required; no new browser journeys planned. Numerical coverage applies only in dedicated post-review phase.

Branches/paths validated:
All acceptance criteria, package/host compatibility matrix, failure/recovery boundaries, no-disk strict mode, authorization negative cases and full pairing-to-restart flow.

Mocking plan:
Use real internal storage, transactions, supervision and host boundaries. Inject fake WhatsApp network transport only at external provider boundary; isolated BEAMs for VM-wide Mnesia state. Configuration resolved at public boundaries; ZAQ runtime config uses Zaq.Config per policy.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Record validation/coverage evidence and exceptions in these Beadwork issues and future PR descriptions; update owner docs only for verified behavior.

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable: verification-only step. Confirm prior reuse assessments and no new agent-tool exposure. No live WhatsApp, commit/push/merge or publication without explicit authorization.

Validation and E2E:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md and docs/testing-approach.md; package follows its own quality gate. No new UI or user journey: no new E2E authoring required. Implementation must preserve existing assertions and include property tests for isolation/idempotence/capacity invariants.

web_widget-influenced refinement (user-authorized plan update):
Additional validation matrix: explicit child absent/present, invalid/duplicate startup, immutable option replacement, automatic transport compatibility, readiness during reconciliation, stale-generation operations, missing infrastructure before prepare/seed, and retained database/RAM namespace separation. Test global Mnesia state only in isolated BEAMs. No browser or live-provider scope expansion.

Expanded upstream extraction scope (supersedes earlier references to retaining ZAQ Storage/Session): package owns temporary storage, pairing lifecycle, generic namespace routing/serialization and confirmation/handoff. ZAQ keeps only thin authorization/encrypted-persistence/connector callbacks in existing responsibility-compatible facades. All four modules under lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/ must be deleted; no equivalent state machine relocated elsewhere. Preserve this step's existing backend, lifecycle, rollout and validation requirements. New prerequisite issues cover the additional package and host API work. Final verification includes absent directory and references, no renamed local implementation, package compiles/tests independently of ZAQ, identity/owner/expiry/cancel contracts, frozen retries, persistence idempotency, seed/start partial failure and real DB/RAM separation. Preserve current UI/journeys and existing full-flow assertions.

## PR #847 remediation scope (zaq-e5z)

Reused final validation/acceptance issue for zaq-e5z. New prerequisite zaq-e5z.12; preserve historical prerequisite zaq-0l7.24.5. The PR #847 scope here supersedes older statements that no new E2E authoring is required: its single E2E owner remains zaq-0l7.8 after zaq-0l7.7 approval. Do not duplicate browser work or coverage workflow: dedicated current coverage is zaq-e5z.12 after zaq-e5z.11 actual approval.
Require completed package delivery/pin, every new child contract, reused start/stop issue, consolidated E2E and reviewed coverage fixes. Audit exact final revisions and preservation of jido_chat/Amarula, normalized phone/name, super-admin WhatsApp enablement, backend-neutral idempotent cleanup, full-lifetime startup exclusion and polling semantics. Record staged/uncommitted state honestly; do not discard docs/architecture.md correction.
Execute final mix precommit using Context Mode and authoritative WORKFLOW_AGENT phase-6 timing/failure gates; required package non-live suite/quality and changed integrated tests must already have evidence. Run no redundant full suite merely for repetition. Resolve failures, rerun required gates, then request final human approval. This issue stays open until actual final approval is recorded; plan/UX/review approval alone is insufficient. Commits/push/merge/publication remain separately authorized.
Existing-test exceptions are only those explicitly approved in zaq-e5z.1 and zaq-e5z.8; other semantic changes need disclosure/approval. No live WhatsApp smoke is authorized or claimed. Action reuse: validation-only; audit recorded operation decisions and no new exposed tools.
